existing_group_assignments.rationale: Decline in population trajectory is the same decreased population-level outcome as 'Decreased, Population trajectory'.
Decreased intratesticular testosterone is the same decreased testosterone endpoint in a specific compartment (testis).
Increased reactive oxygen and nitrogen species is a closely related generalized oxidative stress/ROS event.
Increased oxidative DNA damage is a specific form of increased DNA damage.
Increased DNA damage and mutation relates to increased DNA damage with different specificity.
Impaired ovulation is an ovulation outcome related to decreased/delayed ovulation with differing specifics.

new_groups.rationale: Reduced progesterone synthesis vs decreased progesterone levels are the same reduced hormone endpoint at different process/compartment levels.
Both concern the GnRH receptor gene; promoter hypermethylation and decreased expression are distinct processes.
Both concern retinoic acid signaling; decreased atRA concentration and decreased RAR activation are distinct processes.
